analysis: The code snippet defines a method that retrieves the UID of an application given a PackageManager and a package name. It calls manager.getApplicationInfo(packageName,0).uid, which can throw PackageManager.NameNotFoundException (a checked exception). The current code catches this exception and wraps it in an IllegalArgumentException, a runtime exception that is intended to propagate to higher-level handlers. Runtime exceptions that may occur (e.g., NullPointerException if manager or packageName is null) are not caught, but handling them is not required as they indicate programming errors. Therefore, no additional runtime exception handling is necessary within this snippet.
